title: Readable Is Not Steerable: Pre-Registered Tests of Physical Structure in Learned Fluid Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.05577v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Self-supervised world models are often said to organize their latents around physical quantities. We test this on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow in three pre-registered studies, each tested once on held-out data. In Study 1, a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) trained to predict the flow fails the pre-registered criteria for organizing its latent around fluid quantities better than an untrained network of the same architecture (not supported); a JEPA trained on non-physical linear dynamics and a static invariance model that never sees time do as well or better. In Study 2, plain autoencoders that render the field make enstrophy prominent in their slowest unsupervised latent directions (best r 0.80-0.86 vs 0.38 untrained; fresh seeds, sealed data). translated_title: 可读性不等于可操控性：对学习到的流体表征中物理结构的预注册测试
translated_abstract: 自监督世界模型常被认为会围绕物理量来组织其潜在表示。我们在二维衰减的纳维-斯托克斯流动上通过三项预注册研究检验了这一说法，每项研究仅在保留数据上测试一次。在研究1中，训练用于预测流场的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）未能满足预注册标准，即其潜在表示围绕流体量的组织程度并不优于相同架构的未训练网络（假设不被支持）；而在非物理线性动力学上训练的JEPA，以及从未接触时间信息的静态不变性模型，表现得与其相当甚至更好。在研究2中，渲染流场的普通自编码器使其最慢的无监督潜在方向上涡量耗散（enstrophy）变得显著（最佳相关系数 r 为 0.80-0.86，而未训练网络为 0.38；采用全新随机种子和封存数据）。添加 VICReg 在所有比较中都降低了这种显著性，尽管在涡度方面未达到预注册的差距，同时提高了自编码器的线性可解码性（部分支持……）
tldr: 该研究通过预注册实验发现，自监督模型学到的流体表征虽然具有线性可解码的“可读性”，但并不围绕物理量组织——JEPA表现不优于未训练网络，而普通自编码器反而在最慢潜在方向上突出涡量耗散，且添加VICReg正则化会削弱这种物理结构。
en_tdlr: Pre-registered tests on 2D decaying Navier-Stokes flow demonstrate that readable representations are not steerable: JEPA fails to organize latents around fluid quantities better than untrained networks, while plain autoencoders prominently encode enstrophy in their slowest latent directions—and adding VICReg diminishes this physical structure.
